description: This file defines a template class 'FastUniformBits' for generating uniform random bits efficiently from a URBG (Uniform Random Bit Generator). It includes utility functions for range calculations, power-of-two checks, and bit masking, and implements different algorithms based on the range properties of the generator.

classes.name: FastUniformBits
classes.description: A template class providing fast uniform random bits generation from a URBG, optimized for ranges that are powers of two or not.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Generates a random value using the underlying URBG, dispatching to specialized algorithms based on range properties.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Internal method to generate random bits using either a simplified or rejection-based algorithm.
